name: mock-browser
description: WireMock stand-in for an A2A 1.0 browser (local development only). It answers every request with the same words, so a scenario can tell its answer from any other.

skills.name: Look
skills.description: Looks for pictures on the web and answers with the ones it found.
examples: Find pictures to illustrate football in Europe from 2011 to 2019.
